key_provisions_or_claims: Adopts updated RAPEX guidelines in the Annex and repeals Decision 2010/15/EU.
Member States must notify serious-risk product measures with cross-border effects via RAPEX (GPSD Art. 12, Reg. 765/2008 Art. 22).
Sets deadlines: 3 days for emergency notifications, 10 days for standard ones, with follow-up within 20 to 45 days.
Includes Appendix 6 risk assessment guidelines for identifying serious risks.
Sets rules on public disclosure (Safety Gate), confidentiality and national RAPEX contact points.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/417 adopts updated guidelines for managing RAPEX, the EU rapid alert system for dangerous non-food consumer products. It sets notification criteria, content, deadlines, follow-up, confidentiality and publication rules, plus risk assessment methods under the General Product Safety Directive and Regulation 765/2008. It has no AI or robotics content.
